hero.subtitle: Stop retyping invoices by hand. Upload a PDF from Stripe, PayPal, Wix or Google and AI will generate a fully compliant Bulgarian invoice — ready for your accountant.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
problem.subtitle: Every month Bulgarian companies lose hours manually retyping foreign invoices.

manual.title: Manual retyping
manual.desc: Copying field by field from a PDF into a template. Every month. For every invoice.

errors.title: Data errors
errors.desc: One wrong digit in the company ID or VAT amount — and accounting sends the invoice back.

compliance.title: VAT non-compliance
compliance.desc: Foreign invoices don't contain the mandatory fields required by Bulgarian law.

time.title: Wasted time
time.desc: 15+ minutes per invoice. With 20 invoices a month, that's 5 hours of pure loss.

solution.title: One upload. Done.
solution.subtitle: AI extracts every field from the original invoice and transforms it into a fully compliant Bulgarian format.

upload.label: Upload
upload.desc: Drop a PDF invoice from any provider

extract.label: Extract
extract.desc: AI reads and recognizes every field instantly

generate.label: Generate
generate.desc: An invoice meeting all VAT law requirements is created

download.label: Download
download.desc: Get a perfect PDF, ready for accounting

providers.title: Works with all popular platforms
providers.subtitle: Stripe, PayPal, Wix, Google, Shopify and many more — if it's a PDF invoice, we understand it.

ai.title: AI accuracy
ai.desc: GPT-4o reads even non-standard formats with over 99% precision.

compliance.title: VAT law compliance
compliance.desc: All mandatory fields — company ID, VAT number, accountable person, tax base, amount in words.

speed.title: Lightning fast
speed.desc: From upload to finished PDF in under 30 seconds.

edit.title: Full control
edit.desc: Review and edit every field before generating.

secure.title: Secure
secure.desc: Files are processed instantly and never stored on the server.

free.title: No installation
free.desc: Works directly in the browser — on desktop, tablet or phone.

finalCta.title: Ready to save hours every month?
finalCta.subtitle: Upload your first invoice and see the magic yourself.

footer.tagline: Turn any foreign invoice into a fully compliant Bulgarian one in under 30 seconds. No retyping, no errors, no headaches.

trust.secure: Files never stored on our servers

footer.poweredBy: Powered by GPT-4o · Built for WEB SERVICES BULGARIA LTD
